method.aggregation: days-in-month weighted annual mean; 12 finite months required
method.model: OLS with intercept and centered calendar year
method.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64; Neumaier summation; Lanczos/continued-fraction Student t

warnings: MERRA-2 grid-cell reanalysis; not a city weather station. No independent station validation.
HAC/t inference is approximate; reanalysis structural uncertainty is not quantified.
